# With -versions, a static build writes each published tag, built from
# its own commit, and the working tree as latest, each in a directory
# of its own, with a manifest the version switcher reads.

git init -q
git add docs examples
git commit -q -m v0.1.9
git tag v0.1.9
cp v0.1.10/hello.go examples/hello.go
git commit -q -am v0.1.10
git tag v0.1.10
git mv docs/agents/agents.md docs/agents.md
cp next/docs/index.md docs/index.md
cp next/examples/hello.go examples/hello.go
git commit -q -am reorganize

md2html -html out -versions -version-pattern 'v*' -include-root . docs
exists out/versions.json out/versions/index.html
grep '"name": "v0.1.10"' out/versions.json
grep '"state": "stable"' out/versions.json

# Every version shows the code it shipped, not today's.
grep '// main' out/latest/guide.html
grep '// v0.1.10' out/v0.1.10/guide.html
grep '// v0.1.9' out/v0.1.9/guide.html

# A version that moved a page keeps its own paths; latest keeps a
# redirect at the old one, and the manifest maps it for the switcher.
exists out/v0.1.9/agents/agents.html
grep 'url=../agents.html' out/latest/agents/agents.html
grep '"agents/agents": "agents"' out/versions.json

# Pages carry a switcher scoped to their version.
grep 'data-versions="../../versions.json"' out/v0.1.9/agents/agents.html
grep 'data-version="v0.1.9"' out/v0.1.9/agents/agents.html

# The root opens the default version, and unversioned URLs still work.
grep 'url=latest/' out/index.html
grep 'url=latest/guide.html' out/guide.html

# -versions-only builds a subset; -version-alias publishes a copy.
md2html -html some -versions -version-pattern 'v*' -versions-only v0.1.9 -version-alias stable=newest-tag -include-root . docs
! exists some/latest
! exists some/stable
md2html -html aliased -versions -version-pattern 'v*' -version-alias stable=newest-tag -include-root . docs
grep '// v0.1.10' aliased/stable/guide.html
! md2html -html bad -versions -versions-only v9.9.9 docs
stderr 'no version v9.9.9'

# A build into a directory holding an earlier one replaces its pages
# at the root with redirects.
mkdir stale
cp docs/guide.md stale/guide.html
md2html -html stale -versions -version-pattern 'v*' -include-root . docs
grep 'url=latest/guide.html' stale/guide.html

# Names md2html gives directories at the root name no version.
git tag versions
md2html -html reserved -versions -version-pattern 'v*' -include-root . docs
! grep '"name": "versions"' reserved/versions.json
grep 'href="../latest/"' reserved/versions/index.html
git tag -d versions
# Case does not matter: many file systems ignore it.
git tag Versions
md2html -html reserved3 -versions -version-pattern '[vV]*' -include-root . docs
! grep '"name": "Versions"' reserved3/versions.json
git tag -d Versions
cp policy/reserved.yaml docs/versions.yaml
! md2html -html reserved2 -versions -version-pattern 'v*' -include-root . docs
stderr 'archive name "latest" is reserved'
rm docs/versions.yaml

# since: in versions.yaml publishes no tag older than it, and no
# prerelease.
cp policy/versions.yaml docs/versions.yaml
git tag v0.1.11-pre.0
md2html -html floor -versions -version-pattern 'v*' -include-root . docs
exists floor/v0.1.10
! exists floor/v0.1.9
! exists floor/v0.1.11-pre.0
! grep 'v0.1.11-pre.0' floor/versions.json
git tag -d v0.1.11-pre.0
rm docs/versions.yaml

# With -search, the manifest names each version's own index, which
# search across versions loads on request.
md2html -html searched -versions -version-pattern 'v*' -search -include-root . docs
grep '"search": "search-index\.[0-9a-f]+\.js"' searched/versions.json
grep 'id="search-all-versions"' searched/v0.1.9/guide.html
# The search scripts are the same in every version and kept once.
grep 'src="./../_shared/js/search\.[0-9a-f]+\.js" data-root="./"' searched/v0.1.9/guide.html
! exists searched/v0.1.9/js

# The server serves the working tree at the root and each other
# version under /v/<name>/, all of it read at that version's commit.
md2html -http :9147 -watch=false -versions -version-pattern 'v*' -include-root . docs &
wait-port :9147
curl -s http://localhost:9147/guide
stdout '// main'
curl -s http://localhost:9147/v/v0.1.9/guide
stdout '// v0.1.9'
curl -s http://localhost:9147/v/v0.1.9/agents/agents
stdout 'Agents call tools'
curl -s http://localhost:9147/versions.json
stdout '"path": "v/v0.1.10/"'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:9147/v/v9.9.9/guide
stdout 404
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}' http://localhost:9147/agents/agents
stdout '301 http://localhost:9147/agents'

-- docs/index.md --
# Home

See [agents](agents/agents.md).
-- docs/guide.md --
# Guide

<Code src="/examples/hello.go" />
-- docs/agents/agents.md --
# Agents

Agents call tools in a loop until the task is done, then they stop.
-- examples/hello.go --
package main // v0.1.9
-- v0.1.10/hello.go --
package main // v0.1.10
-- next/examples/hello.go --
package main // main
-- policy/versions.yaml --
since: v0.1.10
-- policy/reserved.yaml --
archive:
  - name: latest
    path: archive
-- next/docs/index.md --
# Home

See [agents](agents.md).
